Package index

Package overview

rddid-package
rddid: treatment effects at a cutoff shared with a confounding policy

Estimate

The RD-DID estimator and what to do with a fit.

rddid()
Estimate the effect of a treatment at a cutoff shared with a confounding policy
summary(<rddid>) print(<summary.rddid>)
Summary of an RD-DID fit
plot(<rddid>)
Plot the per-period RD fits behind an RD-DID estimate
coef(<rddid>) confint(<rddid>) nobs(<rddid>)
Coefficients, confidence intervals and sample size of an RD-DID fit
tidy(<rddid>) glance(<rddid>) tidy(<rd_typecont>) tidy(<rd_compstable>) tidy(<rd_homog>) tidy(<rd_trendcell>)
Tidy output for RD-DID fits and validation tests

Check the assumptions

Tests of the identification assumptions when the running variable moves over time, so that units can change side of the cutoff between periods.

rd_typecont()
Test of type continuity
rd_compstable()
Test of composition stability
rd_homog()
Test of homogeneous confounding
rd_trendcell()
Test of constant within-type confounding
plot(<rd_typecont>)
Plot a type-continuity test: one comparison period against one RD period
plot(<rd_compstable>)
Plot a composition-stability test: the reflected sample of one pair of periods
plot(<rd_homog>)
Plot a homogeneous-confounding test: the confounding jump of each type, by comparison period
plot(<rd_trendcell>)
Plot a constant-within-type-confounding test: each type's confounding jump over time
plot_switchers()
Plot the switchers: the running variable in one period against another

Building blocks

The local-linear RD in one period and its CCT bandwidths, for working period by period.

rd_period()
Local-linear RD in one period (building block)
rd_bw_cct()
CCT bandwidths for one period (building block)

Data

Simulated panels for trying things out.

rddid_sim
Simulated RD-DID panel (running variable fixed over time)
rddid_sim_pv
Simulated RD-DID panel (running variable moves over time)
